description: Call this tool to build a contract from library clauses as .docx or markdown. A variable you omit stays as a bracketed prompt, never invented. clause_ids order is document order. Free: 8 clauses.

categories.description: Instead of ids: every clause in these categories, ordered by category. Free tier: up to 8 clauses per document

clause_ids.description: Clause ids in the order they should appear; this is the document order. Free tier: up to 8 clauses per document

client.description: Client name; also fills the {{client}} variable

format.description: docx (default) or markdown; the document opens with the not-legal-advice line either way

out_path.description: Where to write the file. Default: the server data directory, under a name built from the client and the title

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Without it an existing file is never touched

title.description: Document title, for example 'Service Agreement - Beta Corp'

values.description: Values for the {{variables}} in the chosen clauses, for example {"fee":"4500","late_fee_percent":"2"}. Any variable you leave out stays in the document as a bracketed prompt such as [late fee percent], never as an invented value

name: contract_assemble
title: Assemble a contract
